issue_request: FHIR-18522 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive correction for OperationOutcome asking to remove the comma in the fatal issue-severity definition: "action to fail, and no further" should read "action to fail and no further".
initial_application: The Jira comment records git 50a7112fef. That commit, titled "GF#18522 - fix typo", changed source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-spreadsheet.xml to remove exactly the requested comma. Later source reorganization moved the terminology into source/operationoutcome/codesystem-issue-severity.xml while preserving the corrected wording.
additional_context: OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/operationoutcome/codesystem-issue-severity.xml currently defines fatal as "The issue caused the action to fail and no further checking could be performed." Searching active source found no remaining old comma text; the old text appears only in historical release snapshots under tools/history. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the authoritative current source already satisfies the Jira request.
